cues.en: to call it a project, because there's no serious intent to make anything.

cues.en: Tinkering is never worth it because there is no 'it.' You just can't finish a project until you

cues.zh: 先定义什么叫“完成”！无限地整理线缆、摆弄你的 3D 打印机、
cues.en: define what 'finishing' is! Infinitely rearranging your cables, fiddling with your 3D printer,

cues.zh: 改你树莓派的终端配色……你这是在浪费生命。别瞎搞了。
cues.en: changing your Raspberry Pi's terminal color... you are wasting your life. Stop messing around.

cues.zh: 把线缆往桌底一扔，去打打游戏。把打印机重新装好，
cues.en: Throw the cables under the desk and play some games. Reassemble the printer and

cues.zh: 打印点东西。记住你买树莓派是为了造一台赛博终端，所以
cues.en: print some stuff. Remember that you bought that Raspberry Pi to build a cyberdeck so

cues.zh: 就给我造一台赛博终端出来！我没法用一个项目来说明这一点，因为如果我给你看
cues.en: build a damn cyberdeck! I can't illustrate this with a project, because if I showed

cues.zh: 我某个半成品，就会剧透未来的一集。
cues.en: you one of my works-in-progress, it would spoil a future episode.

cues.zh: 等等，其实我可以，因为这是我的节目，而且我已经剧透过了！我的下一个项目
cues.en: Wait, yes I can, because it's my show, and I already did! My next project is going

cues.zh: 就是一台赛博终端——一台为反乌托邦未来打造的加固便携式电脑。
cues.en: to be a cyberdeck - that's a ruggedized portable computer for a dystopian future.

cues.zh: 我已经买了这块显示屏、这个电池组，还有这台Raspberry Pi 400，
cues.en: I've already bought this display, this battery pack, and this Raspberry Pi 400,

cues.zh: 还做了一些测试和草图。如果我现在毫无计划地直接开干，
cues.en: and did some tests and sketches. If I just jumped in now without a plan,

cues.zh: 第一件事就是想打开Fusion 360开始给框架建模。那就太蠢了，
cues.en: the first thing I want to do is hit Fusion 360 and start modeling that frame. That would be stupid,

cues.zh: 因为如果我先设计电路板，就能在等板子到货的时候给框架建模。
cues.en: because if I instead design the circuit board first, I can model the frame while I wait for

cues.zh: 如果时间赶得上，我就能开始打印框架，再利用这段等待时间
cues.en: the boards to arrive. If I finish in time, I can start printing the frame and use that downtime to

cues.zh: 把元件焊到板子上。仅仅靠列个清单、稍微调整一下顺序，
cues.en: populate the board. By doing literally nothing except making a list and rearranging it a little,

cues.zh: 我现在就能同时做两件必不可少的事，而且总有个好玩的事可以期待。
cues.en: I can now do two tasks at once, both essential, and always have something fun to look forward to.

cues.zh: 这个清单上有很多事要做，但没有一件是"随便鼓捣"、
cues.en: There are lots of things to do on this list but none of them are 'noodle around,'

cues.zh: "无休止地微调"、"拖延"、"看看Home Depot有什么打折"，
cues.en: 'tweak endlessly,' 'procrastinate,' 'see what's on sale at Home Depot,'

cues.zh: 以及其他各种让瞎折腾露出丑陋又浪费的真面目的方式。
cues.en: and other ways tinkering rears its ugly, wasteful head.

cues.zh: 这些策略能帮你今年完成项目——甚至现在就能用上。
cues.en: These are the strategies you can use to finish your project this year - or even right now.

cues.zh: 第一：砍掉不值得完成的项目，不管你已经投入了多少。
cues.en: One: Kill projects that aren't worth finishing, no matter what you've put into them.

cues.zh: 第二：项目一旦能跑就发布，
cues.en: Two: Release projects as soon as they work,

cues.zh: 哪怕你觉得还不够完善，或者以后还得再加功能。
cues.en: even if you feel inadequate or you have to add on more features later.

cues.zh: 第三：制定退出计划，只做能推动项目更接近完成的事。
cues.en: Three: Make an exit plan and only work on things that move the project closer to completion.
